title: Transporting a finite coefficient-unit arrow followed by a local arrow

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: For the finite realization and normalized push square data of finite_unit_push [lem-diagonal-finite-unit-push], let z run from the condensed coefficient unit on P to any derived object W, and v run from eP.derived W to a finite derived object W-prime. Define eP.unitIsoDerived by the single-object unit comparison, the single of its ordinary unit isomorphism, and the inverse finiteUnitComparison. Its hom is eP.derivedUnit. Then the finite realization of coefficientUnitPush followed by the direct image of z, then the supplied push comparison and the direct image of v, equals eY.derivedUnit followed by finiteAdjunct of unitIsoDerived inverse, eP.derived(z), and v [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push].

proof.text: The hom of the explicitly constructed unit isomorphism is the prescribed finite derived unit. Apply finite_unit_push, use naturality of the push comparison on z, insert and cancel this unit isomorphism, and finish with finiteUnitAdjunct_naturality.

theorem finite_unit_arrow_transport
    {R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}} [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (eY : FiniteRealization R A Y) (eP : FiniteRealization R A (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (D : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar R (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (D' : DiagonalRightDerived (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (hc : D'.R = geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (hcanonical : IsCanonicalRightDerived
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) D' hc)
    (s : FinitePushSquare R A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) eP eY D D')
    {W : DerivedCategory (Modules R (ProjectiveLine Y))}
    {W' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))}
    (z : unit R (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶ W) (v : eP.F.mapDerivedCategory.obj W ⟶ W') :
    let t := s.derived.iso.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft eP.F.mapDerivedCategory (eqToIso hc).hom
    eY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map (coefficientUnitPush R Y D ≫ D.R.map z) ≫
        (t.app W ≫ (geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map v) =
      eY.derivedUnit ≫
        finiteAdjunct A Y ((eP.unitIsoDerived.inv ≫ eP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map z) ≫ v)
